scope: Full-regression failure diagnosis and test-only correction

correction: Retain Customer in host module global scope, matching ordinary application model lifetime. Keep explicit gc.collect before real compiler in cleanup control. No product code change.
other_change: Trim trailing blank line in new opt-in SQLModel profile; no behavior change.
